How this system works

Everything on every site is an object in a governed store, edited through one MCP contract. This manual is itself made of those objects, published through the same front door agents use.

  • The object lifecycle — checkout, patch, publish, release.
  • Roles and access — who may do what, and how it is enforced.
  • How a site is born — from one command to a live tenant.

Type reference

  • page
  • section
  • navigation
  • taxonomy
  • site
  • template
  • section_template
  • theme
  • product
  • content_item
